title: build(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 6.5.0 to 7.0.0

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: One read-only metadata request to the exact pinned website package endpoint used normal Windows TLS validation and failed before HTTP. Schannel reported SEC_E_ILLEGAL_MESSAGE (0x80090326), curl exited 35, and HTTP status was 000; no peer certificate or dependency metadata was received. The transitive dependency graph and earlier plugin attribution remain unresolved. The network or proxy owner must diagnose or permit normally validated TLS to registry.npmjs.org on port 443 before retrying that exact endpoint. No package, install, build, or certificate-validation bypass occurred; the review remains in progress.
